id: typescript-channels-sender-scoped-group-policy-ignores-route-allowlist
title: resolveSenderScopedGroupPolicy called unconditionally, downgrading routed group allowlist policy
summary: 'The group policy is rewritten by resolveSenderScopedGroupPolicy using only the sender allowlist
  (groupAllowFrom). When a route-level group allowlist is configured but the sender list is empty, the
  helper relaxes the policy (e.g. allowlist to open). Messages from any sender in a routed group then
  pass the sender check, so the routed group policy is lost. The fix keeps the original groupPolicy when
  a route allowlist is configured and the sender list is empty.

  '
cwe:
- CWE-863
severity: medium
confidence: medium
languages:
- typescript
source:
  kind: fix-commit
  ref: e64a881ae0fb8af18e451163f4c2d611d60cc8e4
  vulnerable_ref: e64a881ae0fb8af18e451163f4c2d611d60cc8e4^
  patched_ref: e64a881ae0fb8af18e451163f4c2d611d60cc8e4
  repository: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw
rule:
  message: 'resolveSenderScopedGroupPolicy is called without preserving the original groupPolicy when
    a route/group allowlist is configured and the sender allowlist is empty. This can silently relax the
    routed group policy. Guard the call with a check on the route allowlist and the empty sender list.

    '
  patterns:
  - pattern: "const $POL = resolveSenderScopedGroupPolicy({\n  groupPolicy: $GP,\n  groupAllowFrom: $GAF,\n\
      });\n"
  - pattern-not-inside: 'const $POL = $COND ? $GP : resolveSenderScopedGroupPolicy({...});

      '
  - pattern-not-inside: "const $POL =\n  $COND\n    ? $GP\n    : resolveSenderScopedGroupPolicy({...});\n"
fix:
  guidance: Before narrowing the group policy to a sender-scoped one, check whether a route or group allowlist
    is configured while the sender allowlist is empty. In that case keep the original resolved groupPolicy
    so the routed policy (for example allowlist) is still enforced downstream. Only call resolveSenderScopedGroupPolicy
    otherwise.
  example: "const senderGroupPolicy =\n  routeAllowlistConfigured && configGroupAllowFrom.length === 0\n\
    \    ? groupPolicy\n    : resolveSenderScopedGroupPolicy({\n        groupPolicy,\n        groupAllowFrom:\
    \ configGroupAllowFrom,\n      });\n"
